# Acme Robotics — Leave & Time-Off Policy

## Annual Leave
Full-time employees at Acme Robotics accrue 20 days of paid annual leave per year, accruing at a rate of 1.67 days per completed month of service. Employees may carry over a maximum of 5 unused annual leave days into the following calendar year. Any days beyond 5 are forfeited on December 31.

## Sick Leave

## Parental Leave

Parental leave must be taken within 12 months of the birth or adoption of a child. Employees must give at least 8 weeks written notice before commencing parental leave.

## Unpaid Leave
Employees who have exhausted their paid leave may request unpaid leave of up to 30 days per year, subject to manager approval. Unpaid leave does not affect continuity of service but does pause annual leave accrual for the duration.

demos.question: An employee has worked at Acme for 6 complete months. About how many annual leave days have they accrued, and how many unused days can they carry into the next year?
demos.reasoning:
To calculate the annual leave accrual, we need to multiply the number of months worked (6) by the monthly accrual rate (1.67 days). This gives us 6 x 1.67 = 10.02 days. Since the employee has completed 6 full months, we round down to 10 days.

The maximum carryover amount is 5 unused annual leave days. Therefore, the employee can carry over up to 5 days into the next year.
demos.answer: The employee has accrued approximately 10 days of annual leave and can carry over up to 5 unused days into the next year.
